method: Seven calibrated batches after at least 200ms warmup per document. Three alternating baseline/candidate/Inkmark sequences. Rust sources copied to identical executable path and launched with identical arguments/environment. Additional mixed 1MB layout sweep varies CORE_MARKDOWN_BENCH_PADDING through eight lengths (0..448 by64), alternating source order. Builds, tests and independent review workloads finish before timing. No CPU affinity or machine-wide isolation.

run_groups.initial-*: Exploratory 91145bc measurements before span and continuation fixes; retained, excluded from final claims.
run_groups.paired-*: Final alternating baseline/candidate/Inkmark measurements for references and mixed fixtures.
run_groups.definitions-*: Final definition-heavy scaling measurements (one process per source/engine).
run_groups.phase-*: Independent complete prepare/events operations, including disposal.
run_groups.allocations-*: Separate allocation-counting executable; allocations exclude input/options and count reallocations separately.

notes: Same-line definitions use compact blocks. Multiline, malformed, ambiguous continuation and continued-container tab cases retain grammar block preparation.
All benchmark core outputs preserve the baseline; reference and definition-heavy output agreement with Inkmark is recorded separately.
Reference performance does not establish an overall engine ranking: README HTML comments and GFM still select the compatibility producer.
Allocation requested bytes include growth requests, not peak or retained memory.
Final mixed 100KB and 1MB paired medians are 1.5% and 2.2% slower than baseline; the 1MB layout sweep median is 1.6% slower. No mixed-document speedup is claimed.

validation.saved_output_preservation: 2117 cases across direct, checked events, and arena rendering
validation.independent_review: 36446 cases; no panics, rendering-path mismatches, or definition value/span differences
